bellsprout-power-whip.name: Power Whip
bellsprout-power-whip.description: Bond skill: lashes a foe up to 2 hexes away with a heavy vine (Power 100, Attack).

bellsprout-sludge-bomb.name: Sludge Bomb
bellsprout-sludge-bomb.description: Bond skill: lobs sludge up to 3 hexes away (Power 90, Sp. Atk), Poisoning the foe for 2 turns.

bellsprout-grassy-glide.name: Grassy Glide
bellsprout-grassy-glide.description: Bond skill: glides up to 2 hexes into a foe (Power 55) and engages it.

bellsprout-long-vines.name: Long Vines
bellsprout-long-vines.description: Its moves that reach 2+ hexes reach 1 hex further.

bellsprout-corrosive-sap.name: Corrosive Sap
bellsprout-corrosive-sap.description: Deals 20% more damage to Poisoned foes.

bellsprout-knock-off.name: Knock Off
bellsprout-knock-off.description: New skill: swats the foe hard with a leaf (Power 65).

bellsprout-sticky-nectar.name: Sticky Nectar
bellsprout-sticky-nectar.description: Foes it engages take 15% more damage from its allies.

bellsprout-toxic-drip.name: Toxic Drip
bellsprout-toxic-drip.description: Its hits on adjacent foes Poison them for 2 turns.

bellsprout-poison-jab.name: Poison Jab
bellsprout-poison-jab.description: New skill: stabs with a venomous vine tip (Power 70), Poisoning the foe for 2 turns.

bellsprout-magical-leaf.name: Magical Leaf
bellsprout-magical-leaf.description: New skill: homing leaves at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 60).

bellsprout-swallow.name: Swallow
bellsprout-swallow.description: Heals 20% of max HP when it knocks out a foe.

bellsprout-stockpile.name: Stockpile
bellsprout-stockpile.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

bellsprout-leaf-blade.name: Leaf Blade
bellsprout-leaf-blade.description: New skill: slashes with a razor-edged leaf (Power 90).

bellsprout-leaf-storm.name: Leaf Storm
bellsprout-leaf-storm.description: New skill: a storm of leaves up to 1 hex away (Power 85) hitting a 1-hex area.

bellsprout-venom-pool.name: Venom Pool
bellsprout-venom-pool.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 more turn.

bellsprout-digestive-acid.name: Digestive Acid
bellsprout-digestive-acid.description: When a foe it afflicted faints, adjacent foes catch that status.

bellsprout-seed-bomb.name: Seed Bomb
bellsprout-seed-bomb.description: New skill: hurls a hard seed at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 85).

bellsprout-spit-up.name: Spit Up
bellsprout-spit-up.description: New skill: spews stored digestive fluid at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 90).

bellsprout-sun-fed-leaves.name: Sun-Fed Leaves
bellsprout-sun-fed-leaves.description: Its Grass moves deal 15% more damage.

bellsprout-clinging-vines.name: Clinging Vines
bellsprout-clinging-vines.description: Its free strikes on foes breaking away deal 25% more damage.

bellsprout-pitchers-maw.name: Pitcher's Maw
bellsprout-pitchers-maw.description: Capstone. Deals 25% more damage to foes with any status and takes 10% less damage.

bellsprout-flytrap-frenzy.name: Flytrap Frenzy
bellsprout-flytrap-frenzy.description: Capstone. A knockout resets its skill cooldowns and gives the team 1 Bond.

bellsprout-growth.name: Growth
bellsprout-growth.description: New skill: grows rapidly; Focused for 2 turns.
